commands_used: answer 1. I work for the Toh-Reel-Ka, the order of the Xeech-Leel. The Hist trees are sickening because the Unbound (Cuts-the-Old-Knot) drain and poison them. We want the Eye of Argonia first to heal the trees at the Root. The Collector, Ennodius Vanin, is also hunting it, and his hired men are camped at the Grey Tooth, the seamark of Skeith Isle. 2. Find out what the Collector men found in the Grey Tooth Cave, a door on the north face (quest marker), and also Vanin Rubbing is a marker here. 3. Fight the three hirelings, or slip past them to the cave; I can also look at the rubbing and talk to them. 4. I do not fully understand what the Root gate or the Eye exactly needs, or who Cuts-the-Old-Knot really is. I could find out by exploring, reading and asking people.

answer 1. The cave niche is empty; a sailor scratched that the stone went to the ship Stormwidow by her captain order in year 181. The Collector knows and has sent diggers to the wreck. I still serve the Toh-Reel-Ka and want the Eye before the Unbound. 2. Go to the Wreck of the Stormwidow on the south-west beach of Skeith Isle and search the hold, the ballast crate, for the kings stone. 3. Fight whoever is at the wreck or slip past them; talk to them maybe. 4. I do not know what the kings stone is for, or whether it is a key to the gate. I could find out by finding it and reading.
take Kings' Marker Stone from Stormwidow's Ballast Crate
